Footnote Extraction Test v4 (CSS GCPM float: footnote)

This variant uses real CSS Generated Content for Paged Media footnotes (float: footnote), which WeasyPrint has partial support for, rather than a hand-built <div class="footnotes"> block with manual anchors. The idea is that this produces a genuinely different PDF structure (an actual footnote area at the bottom of the page, generated by the layout engine itself) that Docling's layout model might recognize differently than a styled div that merely looks like a footnote blockThis is a real CSS float:footnote footnote, generated by the layout engine..
